TRAD23 Buying translation – public procurement

Legal basis:

• Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046 on the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union Annex I 

• Vademecum

• EU case law on procurement #Translate4EU

TRAD23 - EU procurement law – general principles (Art. 160 of the Financial Regulation)

• Transparency • Proportionality • Fair and equal treatment • Consistency, integrity, accountability #Translate4EU

TRAD23 - Type of contract

DGT can define WHAT we need (translation) but not WHEN or HOW MUCH

Framework contract for frequently used language combinations

• Very low value contract (simplified) for all others 

#### TRAD23

#### The new call for tenders

TRAD23 - Cascade type of contracts • Up to 3 contractors per language combination • Selection based on testing

• Contractor ranked first should take all jobs, others back-up

• 2 +1 +1 year duration #Translate4EU

TRAD23 - 50 lots covered

 EN into 23

 20 into EN (no ET, GA, MT)

 DE, ES, IT into FR  FR into DA, DE, IT and NL  all other: negotiated procedure (very low value contracts)

• Accuracy

Linguistic and technical requirements

TRAD23 - Quality control

##### 2 steps:

• Evaluation of assignments • Monthly performance assessment #Translate4EU

TRAD23 - Evaluation of assignments

Quality rating 0% - 100%

Quality rating 100% = the assignment:

• fully complies with the quality requirements 
• is usable as it stands on delivery, 
• is ready for publication without any further intervention by DG Translation 

Quality rating < 20.0%: price reduction of 80%

TRAD23 Monthly performance assessment overall performance of the FWC = quality rating of the evaluated pages delivered in the previous month n.

An evaluated page is of sufficient quality (a ‘pass’ page) if its quality rating is 70.0% or higher.

#### TRAD23

#### Timeline & steps of bidding

TRAD23 - Timeline • 1 March 2023: publication of the call for tenders • 6 March 2023: live premiere

• 8 March – 21 April 2023: information sessions in the member states • 31 May 2023 at 15:00 Brussels time: submission deadline • 6 June 2023: opening of tenders • End of June 2023: on-line tests • July 2023: evaluation of tenders starts #Translate4EU

TRAD23 - Who can tender?

• EU citizens

• natural & any kind of legal persons resident/registered in:

 the EU

 Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Iceland, Kosovo, Liechtenstein, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Norway, Serbia and the United Kingdom

TRAD23 – How to tender?

via eSubmission eSubmission Quick Guide

First:

• register in EU Login • create an account on TED eTendering • register in the Participant Register #Translate4EU

TRAD23 – How to tender?

• Start early enough – create a PIC already now 
• You can upload, modify and delete your tender until submission 
• You can withdraw it after submission 
• All data encrypted, not accessible, not even for the support team 
• Decryption takes place after the opening of tenders 
• Questions and answers through eTendering 

Under "Parties" present the tenderer:

 Sole tenderer

 Joint tender: present your partners  Structural subcontractors: present your structural subcontractors

TRAD23 – How to tender?

Under "Lots" select the lots you apply for 
Under "Tender Data" you must upload: 
 One Technical tender 
 One Financial Tender 
PER LOT! 

TRAD23 – How to tender?

Under "Technical tender" present your team for that lot  The team = 1 Quality Coordinator + all linguists who are freelancers or self-employed

 Scan preferably in one single document all papers related to the team

TRAD23 – How to tender?

You will receive a submission report.

This is the proof of your timely submission.

#### Evaluation of the tenders

TRAD23 – Evaluation of tenders

3-step procedure:

I. Exclusion criteria

II. Selection criteria

III. Award criteria #Translate4EU

TRAD23 – I. Exclusion criteria

Standard in all procurement procedures – Art. 136 of Financial Regulation Declaration on honour Joint tender: applies to each member Subcontracting: applies to contractor + all subcontractors (each team member)

TRAD23 – II. Selection criteria

Joint tenders: the group as a whole Subcontracting: tenderer + subcontractors jointly

##### 1. Legal and regulatory capacity PER TENDER

TRAD23 – II. Selection criteria

PER LOT

##### 2. Minimum production capacity 3. Professional capacity

TRAD23 – Minimum production capacity

Output: number of pages delivered in 2022 + Staff numbers 2020-2022 sufficient to produce 30% of the output

TRAD23 – Professional capacity

THE TEAM all translators, revisers and reviewers: professional competences set in ISO 17100

For 2022: at least 50% of manpower needed for the output had these competences

TRAD23 – Professional capacity

THE QUALITY COORDINATOR

Overall responsibility for complying with quality requirements

Contact point for DG Translation

Native speaker level in the target language

ISO17100 + degree + experience in translation + experience in quality assurance

TRAD23 – III. Award criteria

Linguistic test – ca. 4 pages

Project management test

70% 30%

### Price

TRAD23 – 1. Quality criteria

| Criterion | Points | Pass score |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linguistic | test 80 | 56 |
| Project management test | 20 | 14 |
| Total | 100 | 70 |

TRAD23 – 2. Price criterion

You must submit one Financial tender PER LOT The reference price is the price quoted for translating a standard page, expressed in euro (EUR) without VAT including all costs

TRAD23 – Pre-processing

• 20% of the reference price for 100%-match pages 
• 50% for 85-99%-match pages 
• 100% for less than 85%-match pages 

TRAD23 – Ranking [(NQ x 0.7) + (NP x 0.3)] x 100 where: NQ = Q/max (Q) NP = min (P)/(P)

Q = quality score of the evaluated tender max (Q) = the highest quality score for the lot in question

P = the price in euro per standard page

min (P) = the lowest price offered for the lot in question with a quality score of at least 70/100
